intervention: Added the Compound Level 2 Gate: enumerate all triggered delivery rows, split rather than bundle high-risk work, and make rollback, secret, dependency, documentation, and reproducibility decisions explicit.

comparison.conclusion: The protocol-isolated retest covered every critical trap after the compound gate was added. It left the non-critical backfill-budget trap unscored because it named a stop signal but not a concrete load threshold; the prior response missed critical rollback and secret-governance decisions.

limitations: This is a qualitative forward test scored by a transparent lexical floor, not proof of a real payment provider, migration runner, secret manager, CI system, or production rollout.

The same model family and global repository instructions may contribute to both responses; the result supports guidance quality but does not establish a causal estimate independent of the surrounding harness.

The evaluator checks for explicit decisions, not implementation correctness or operational metrics. Real repositories still require their own tests, review, CI, migration rehearsal, and authorized rollout evidence.
